name: The stop judge is shown the blocks people overrode, so the outcome log feeds the next decision
about: What people did after an ask, stop or block was recorded only for analytics and the weekly email: nothing the judge saw changed. The merge also passed no compare, so every block with a later commit read as fixed. The judge's picture now carries the team's recent decisions of the same kind that people's acts showed wrong (same step first), and a merge compares each block's own head.
